proposals.proposedPreparationMethod: Food preparation only: crush the Cymbopogon citratus stalk and use it to flavour cooked soups, curries, seafood or poultry dishes. NParks describes this culinary use, not a treatment dose or a standardized essential-oil recipe. Clinical research used standardized topical or mouth-rinse formulations with measured essential-oil concentrations. The studies do not support a reproducible home preparation.
